# Focus Forge

> Focus Forge is a fast, dark-first task and project management app with a
> built-in AI agent. It works like Todoist, but is designed to be driven by AI
> agents — including autonomous Claude Code loops that clear your backlog through
> pull requests and verify deployments. Built by The Portland Company.

## What it does
- Task management: due dates, priorities, tags, subtasks, reminders, recurring tasks, Today and Upcoming views.
- AI agent: ask questions about any project and have the agent create, edit, and complete tasks. Resilient 3-provider fallback.
- Organizations & projects: multi-org, favorites, archiving, drag-and-drop ordering, role-based team access.
- Calendar & time-blocking: schedule tasks and plan your day.
- Email integration: connected inbox, drafts, and composer next to your tasks.
- DevNotes: structured, machine-readable metadata embedded on a task (branch, PR, deploy status), stored separately from the visible description.

## Autonomous loop
Focus Forge is built to be run by agents. A recurring Claude Code command watches
Focus Forge for new or open tasks, spawns a team of subagents to complete each one
through pull requests, and verifies deployment to staging and production.

The command:
/loop 1m Watch /focus-forge for existing or new Tasks. Spawn a Team of Subagents to complete all of them through PRs, and verify deployment to staging and production.

## Platforms
Web (any modern browser), native iOS, native macOS — one synced account.

## Maker
The Portland Company — Portland, Oregon. https://theportlandcompany.com
